questions.say: Good evening. My name is Alice, and I'm your examiner today. This is the Speaking test. In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about your home. Who do you live with?

questions.text: Do you often invite friends to your home?

questions.text: How often do you go out with friends?

Now let's move on to talk about perfume. Do you wear perfume?

cueCard.topic: Describe a time when you were late for something.
cueCard.explain: and explain how you felt about being late.

questions.text: Describe a time when you were late for something.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you were late for something. You should say: what you were late for; why you were late; what happened as a result; and explain how you felt about being late.

questions.text: Are you usually on time for things?
questions.say: Thank you. Are you usually on time for things?

questions.text: Why is it important to be on time at work?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you were late for something, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all punctuality. Why is it important to be on time at work?

questions.text: Are people in your country usually punctual?
questions.say: Are people in your country usually punctual?

questions.text: In what situations is it acceptable to be late?
questions.say: In what situations is it acceptable to be late?

questions.text: Has technology helped people to manage their time better?
questions.say: Now let's talk about time and technology. Has technology helped people to manage their time better?

questions.text: Why do people today often feel they don't have enough time?
questions.say: Why do people today often feel they don't have enough time?

questions.text: Do you think people will have more free time in the future?
questions.say: Do you think people will have more free time in the future?
